name: exchange-api

dependencies.name: exchange-rate-provider
dependencies.description: ExchangeRate-API (https://v6.exchangerate-api.com) — fetches daily USD-based exchange rates via GET /v6/{API_KEY}/latest/USD; the service picks the requested currency's rate out of the returned rates map. Requires an API key; requires a specPath before the build gate resolves it.

config.description: API key for ExchangeRate-API (v6.exchangerate-api.com), used to authenticate the /v6/{API_KEY}/latest/USD request.

description: Ballerina REST service that lists supported currencies and returns the current exchange rate of a given currency to USD, sourced daily from an external exchange-rate provider. Called only by exchange-webapp; publicly reachable with no sign-in required. Does not perform arbitrary amount conversion, history, or store per-user data.
